rationale: The construction contradicts its own hypothesis — dividing by assets *net of recorded intangibles* mechanically awards the highest scores to firms with large *capitalized* intangibles (goodwill-heavy acquirers), not to firms whose intangibles are unrecorded, and what remains is essentially a rescaled R&D-adjusted ROA with a volatile small-denominator tail rather than a genuine cross-theme interaction.

Advertising spend varies across firms by orders of magnitude more than operating margins, so this ratio is dominated by its denominator and is effectively an inverse advertising-intensity sort — the opposite tilt from the "intangible-heavy firms are underpriced" story it claims to test — and it inherits the low coverage of xad without the compensating conjunction structure.

The acquired-intangible validation channel is economically distinct from the expensed-intangible archive entry and the signed-product form is a legitimate interaction, but the reasoning's claim of "full coverage" is wrong (gdwl is not COALESCEd, so non-acquirers drop out) and the product symmetry means low-cash-flow/low-goodwill firms land in the long leg, which the hypothesis never justifies.

This is a one-leg respecification of the archived ProfitableInnovatorConjunction with identical MIN structure and identical profitability leg, and the substituted leg is dominated by *recorded* intan/goodwill — precisely the capital accounting does capitalize — so it contradicts the "understated book capital" mechanism it purports to retest.

A one-year earnings change scaled by cumulative advertising is dominated by denominator scale (tiny advertisers get enormous absolute scores) and reduces largely to a noisy earnings-momentum/change-in-profitability sort, a well-known effect, on the thinnest available sample.

A rank *difference* is an additive blend of two separately known effects (goodwill/asset intensity and operating profitability), not an interaction — it is exactly the additive construction the companion proposals explicitly argue against — so any resulting spread is uninformative about the conditional mechanism being claimed.
